personas.title: Fleet Operations Manager
personas.mandate: Real-world commercial fleet efficiency, turnaround time, driver satisfaction, equipment utilization across all 4 products.
personas.simulationMission: Audit cross-portfolio end-to-end operational viability, check Fit-to-Quote bridge and cross-system export continuity.

personas.title: Logistics & Supply Chain Systems Architect
personas.mandate: End-to-end data pipelines, equipment spec integrity, Bridge Law axle rules, tare weights, fuel burn physics, Open Logistics Asset Schema.
personas.simulationMission: Inspect Product 01 3D packing validator & tie-downs; Product 04 digital twin 3D/2.5D/CAD projections and JSON schema bridge.

personas.title: Transport Planner
personas.mandate: Interstate lane routing, multi-stop drop sequencing, dispatch rates, spot market margin calculations, solo vs team hours of service schedules.
personas.simulationMission: Stress-test Product 02 Tactical Dispatch HUD (Operating Ratio, diesel surcharges) and Product 03 HOS Planner (Chicago-Dallas, LA-Atlanta corridors, 11h/14h/70h rules).

personas.title: Legal & Compliance Workflow Architect
personas.mandate: FMCSA Part 395 regulatory compliance, Federal Bridge Formula B axle weight limits, 49 CFR § 393.102 cargo securement, audit logs.
personas.simulationMission: Scrutinize HOS compliance engine, ELD 24-hr record of duty status visualization, axle weight violation alerts in Cargo Fit.

personas.title: Accessibility for Spatial & Scientific Interfaces Specialist
personas.mandate: Web accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA/AAA), keyboard accessibility of complex 3D canvases, color contrast of status badges, screen-reader text alternatives.
personas.simulationMission: Run full WCAG 2.1 accessibility scans across all 4 products; audit focus indicators, ARIA landmarks, color contrast, and keyboard operability.

personas.title: Independent Owner-Operator & Freight Buyer
personas.mandate: Evaluate first-impression clarity, zero-onboarding cognitive overhead, quick rate confirmations, mobile readability from a truck cab, and commercial WTP.
personas.simulationMission: Arrive cold at landing screens, test intuitive discoverability of barcode scanning, rate generation, and truck twin customization without prior training.

personas.title: Logistics Adversarial & Boundary Stress Tester
personas.mandate: Test extreme inputs, edge cases, zero-division, oversized cargo exceedances, impossible routes, rapid viewport resize, and UI crash resilience.
personas.simulationMission: Examine all subproducts under stress: extreme cargo rotations, rapid viewport switching, reefer temperature accessorials, team duty switches, CAD viewport collapses.
